lens_perspectives.observation: StreamId frames purpose and seed, numeric context and output seed; current BuildingAppearance feeds a building ID into its purpose stream and fixed nonempty index bound. Naming paths use separate streams and map sampler failures to text.
Seed, StreamId, DeterministicRng and SamplingError are existing distinct owners. NameCatalogError::Sampling(String) loses the specific owned sampler error before returning from a reusable API.
StreamId rejects empty purpose; Seed accepts every u64. index/choose require nonempty input, weighted selection has typed empty/zero/overflow errors, and range_f32 asserts finite ordered endpoints.

Finite opposite-sign endpoints may overflow the subtraction in range_f32 before multiplication; existing 059 conditional range obligation remains open, not a new unique finding or proven caller failure.
Weighted inputs require nonempty, positive, nonoverflowing aggregate sum, not merely individually valid u64 elements. Catalog admission and consumer reachability require separate evidence.
Purpose string, root seed, ordered context, sampled index and serialized name identity have different owners; no claim that all raw numeric or string identities are interchangeable.
Distinct purpose streams intentionally isolate draw counts. No duplicate authority defect is established solely from multiple stream instances or possible output hash collision.
Any later change must account for length framing, byte order, named purposes, draw order, error categories and intentional reproducibility requirements; no RNG or fixture was executed.
SamplingError is a closed three-case native adapter while NameCatalogError wraps its formatted text; do not infer all external weighted failures or panic variants are reachable.
Seed has manual Hash, Ord, formatting and parsing connected to specific canonical encoding and ordering; derive replacement requires separately established behavior equivalence.
A StreamId is a named purpose while Seed is an arbitrary 64-bit word; a 64-bit derived result is not a uniqueness guarantee. Do not manufacture new owners for native boundary values.
The derivation context is a deliberate BLAKE3 protocol key and stream name is an explicit purpose; their stability is meaningful, not an incidental display string.
Byte framing uses little-endian u64 lengths and context words, and finish truncates to eight bytes. Sampling bounds and intentional half-open vs inclusive conversions remain distinct.
